functions.description: Count the distinct circular arrangements of k distinct units around a round table up to rotation.
inputs: the number of distinct units to be arranged around the round table
outputs: the number of circular arrangements of the units up to rotation

functions.description: Count the total number of distinct circular seating arrangements of n people around a round table.
inputs: the total number of distinct people to be seated around the round table, as a positive integer count
outputs: the total number of circular seatings of the people around the table

functions.description: Count the circular seatings in which two specified people sit next to each other by merging them into one block and multiplying by their internal orderings.
inputs: the total number of distinct people to be seated around the round table, as a positive integer count
the name or label of the first of the two particular people who must not sit next to each other
the name or label of the second of the two particular people who must not sit next to each other
outputs: the number of circular seatings in which the two specified people sit next to each other

functions.description: Count the seatings of n people around a round table in which two specified people do not sit next to each other.
inputs: the total number of distinct people to be seated around the round table, as a positive integer count
the name or label of the first of the two particular people who must not sit next to each other
the name or label of the second of the two particular people who must not sit next to each other
outputs: the number of circular seatings in which the two specified people are not next to each other

entry_points.text: In how many ways can ●1 people be seated around a round table if two particular people, ●2 and ●3, refuse to sit next to each other?

params.description: the total number of distinct people to be seated around the round table, as a positive integer count
params.validity_range: Integer n with n of at least 2 for the circular formula (n-1)! to be defined; the restricted-pair count is nonzero only for n of at least 4, since in a table of 3 or fewer every pair is adjacent (answer 0). Must be a finite positive integer.

params.description: the name or label of the first of the two particular people who must not sit next to each other
params.validity_range: Any distinct identifier naming one of the n seated people; must differ from the second restricted person ●3 so that the pair is well defined.

params.description: the name or label of the second of the two particular people who must not sit next to each other
params.validity_range: Any distinct identifier naming one of the n seated people; must differ from the first restricted person ●2, and both ●2 and ●3 must belong to the set of ●1 people.

entry_points.text: In how many ways can 8 people be seated around a round table if two particular people, A and B, refuse to sit next to each other?
